CustomField.label: Max Query Rows (1-2000)
CustomField.description: The maximum number of rows this check's query may return, from 1 to 2000. Defaults to 200. It is a safety cap - raise it deliberately only when a check genuinely needs to read more rows.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Row cap for this check's query, 1-2000 (default 200). Raise only when the check must read more rows.
